title: Searching for "Harmful Refusal": A Psychometric Audit of an AI Safety Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.12409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety benchmarks typically report one overall score for a suite of datasets, each of which may target one or more safety-related attributes, so models with similar overall scores can have very different attribute profiles. Comparing models is more tractable at the level of individual attributes, yet it is often unclear whether even a single dataset's scores isolate any single attribute. One plausible candidate for such an attribute is harmful refusal, a model's tendency to refuse dangerous or policy-violating prompts. We examine whether it constitutes a single, measurable attribute in HELM Safety. Using a construct validity framework that stipulates that an attribute must exist before a test can measure it, we start with HELM Safety's four datasets that might plausibly target harmful refusal, but find that three are saturated. translated_title: 寻找“有害拒绝”：一项AI安全基准的心理测量学审计
translated_abstract: 安全基准通常会为一系列数据集报告一个总体分数，其中每个数据集可能针对一个或多个安全相关属性，因此总体分数相近的模型可能具有截然不同的属性特征。在单个属性层面比较模型更为可行，然而即便对于单个数据集，其分数是否能够分离出任何单一属性往往也不清楚。这类属性的一个合理候选是有害拒绝，即模型拒绝危险或违反政策提示的倾向。我们检验它在HELM Safety中是否构成一个单一且可测量的属性。采用构念效度框架——该框架规定属性必须先于测试存在才能被测量——我们从HELM Safety中四个可能针对有害拒绝的数据集入手，但发现其中三个已饱和。我们对剩下的数据集HarmBench进行两项心理测量学测试，以确定是否诸如单一的属性……
tldr: 本研究运用构念效度框架对HELM Safety基准中的“有害拒绝”属性进行心理测量学审计，发现四个候选数据集中三个已饱和，并对剩余的HarmBench数据集进行两项心理测量学测试以检验其是否测量单一可测属性。
en_tdlr: This study psychometrically audits the HELM Safety benchmark's "harmful refusal" attribute using a construct validity framework, finding three of four candidate datasets saturated and subjecting the remaining HarmBench dataset to two psychometric tests.
